House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Higher Education Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the Hunger-Free Campus grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; HUNGER-FREE CAMPUS. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for the Hunger-Free Campus grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 135A.137. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the Hunger-Free Campus grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; HUNGER-FREE CAMPUS.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for the Hunger-Free Campus grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 135A.137.
